body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Five LLM-adjacent maintenance tools report success, or hang, when the work they were asked to do did not happen:
- rejection-mining `--limit`/`--min` used parseInt, so `--limit 1e3` mined 1 PR and `--limit 50x` mined 50, exit 0. Its refineCluster accepted any truthy title/charter, so a reply like {"title":12345,"charter":{}} crashed the human report with a TypeError and, under --json --write, was reported refined:true and written into a lens Charter as '[object Object]'.
- lesson-foundry --llm swallowed every per-cluster provider error; with no working provider it wrote unrefined artifacts, reported nothing and exited 0. Its --write preserve rule was existence-only, so a 0-byte artifact (which the gate correctly refuses to credit) was reported 'exists (skipped)' and the gate stayed red until --force overwrote every hand-refined artifact; the truncating writeFileSync is what creates that 0-byte state.
- model-ratchet ran each --review-cmd with spawnSync and no timeout, so one stalled reviewer hung the whole scheduled run with no summary, ledger entry or exit code.
- skill-rot's formatter derived status from its own counts: a skill whose claims were all unverifiable printed [OK] and counted clean while the checker reported allOk:false and did not stamp it. Its node_modules/.git exclusion was applied to every directory's absolute real path, including the root the caller named (an explicit root under node_modules found nothing), and a symlink into node_modules was silently skipped even in strict explicit-path mode behind a clean exit 0.
- merge-forecast passed process.cwd() as the forecast root. From a subdirectory, tree-walk paths were cwd-relative while scopes and git co-change paths are repo-root-relative, so every scope matched 0 files and a co-change gate failure (exit 2) became exit 0 whenever --tickets was given.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Each package is `packages/<pkg>` with bin/<pkg>.mjs (thin CLI) and lib/*.mjs; tests run with `npm test -w packages/<pkg>`. Use `tmp`/`gitRepo` from `@adlc/core/test-kit` for fixtures (the tmp-fixture boundary guard rejects leaked temp dirs). LLM paths are driven end to end with a fake agy binary: ADLC_PROVIDER=agy, ADLC_AGY=<path to a script that drains stdin then prints a fixed reply>.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. rejection-mining: one validator lib/int-flag.mjs `parsePositiveInt` (whole token matches ^[1-9][0-9]*$ and is a safe integer) used for --limit and --min; anything else exits 1 with `--<flag> must be a positive integer (got: <value>)`, before any gh call. lib/llm.mjs `toRefinement` returns {title, charter} trimmed only when both are non-empty strings, else null; a null counts as a failed refinement, so all-failed exits 1 with the existing message.
2. lesson-foundry: after refineClusters, zero refinements under --llm exits 1 with `LLM refinement failed for all clusters. Use --prompt-only to inspect prompts.` before any write. --json clusters carry `refined: boolean`; the human report prints `LLM refinement failed for N of M cluster(s); those keep unrefined wording` when 0 < N. lib/llm.mjs `toRefinement` requires name/description/rule as non-empty strings. lib/artifact-io.mjs exports `hasDefenseContent` (non-whitespace string), used by BOTH the gate's legacy-credit check in lib/foundry.mjs and the --write preserve rule; an existing artifact without content is regenerated and logged `empty (regenerated): <path>` and is not listed in writeSkipped. Artifacts are written with `writeFileAtomic` (sibling temp file + rename; temp removed on failure).
3. model-ratchet: runReviewCmd(reviewCmd, file, cwd, { timeoutMs }) passes timeout and killSignal SIGKILL to spawnSync and returns timedOut and signal; DEFAULT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS = 600000. New flag --timeout-ms (plain positive integer, else exit 1). lib `reviewRunError` maps a run to its per-file error: `review-cmd timed out after <n>ms`, `review-cmd was killed by <signal>`, `review-cmd exited with code <n>` (exit codes 0 and 2 are not errors). The loop continues past a failed file and the run exits 1.
4. skill-rot: status and summary derive from the checker's allOk. [OK] and `clean` only when allOk; claims present but none verified and none stale is [UNVERIFIED], counted in a new summary field `unverified` (table summary appends `, N unverified`), JSON skill gets `unverified: true`. Exit codes unchanged. find-skills judges the node_modules/.git exclusion relative to the realpath of the search root; child entries with those names are still skipped; a symlink whose target resolves into an excluded directory is skipped in default discovery and throws `symlink into an excluded directory: ...` in strict mode (bin exits 1).
5. merge-forecast: the forecast root is `repoRoot(cwd)` inside a git work tree, the cwd outside one; an unresolvable root (isGitRepo true, rev-parse --show-toplevel fails, e.g. cwd is .git) is an operational error `cannot resolve the git repository root: ...`. --tickets and --graph-coupling resolve from cwd.
6. Documentation: update each packages/<pkg>/README.md and make the same edit by hand in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/<pkg>.mdx (hand-maintained mirrors); model-ratchet's synopsis in docs/package-reference.md gains --timeout-ms.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 rejection-mining refuses 1e3, 50x, 0, -3, padded, 2.5, 0x10, +4 and unsafe integers for --limit and --min with exit 1, and the parsed values reach gh and clustering. verify: `node --test packages/rejection-mining/test/strict-int-flags.test.mjs`
- AC2 rejection-mining treats non-string or blank title/charter as a failed refinement (exit 1, no TypeError, no lens written) and trims valid ones. verify: `node --test packages/rejection-mining/test/refinement-shape.test.mjs`
- AC3 lesson-foundry --llm exits 1 without writing when no cluster is refined, reports refined per cluster, and prints the failed-N-of-M line. verify: `node --test packages/lesson-foundry/test/llm-refinement-exit.test.mjs`
- AC4 lesson-foundry --write regenerates a 0-byte or whitespace-only artifact, after which --gate exits 0; a non-empty hand edit is still preserved; writes are atomic. verify: `node --test packages/lesson-foundry/test/empty-artifact-rewrite.test.mjs`
- AC5 model-ratchet kills a review-cmd after --timeout-ms, records a per-file error, continues, and exits 1; bad --timeout-ms exits 1. verify: `node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/review-timeout.test.mjs`
- AC6 skill-rot shows an unverifiable-only skill as [UNVERIFIED], not clean, and does not stamp it. verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/unverified-status.test.mjs`
- AC7 skill-rot searches a root under node_modules/.git, still skips those names below the root, and errors in strict mode on a symlink into them. verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/excluded-dirs.test.mjs`
- AC8 merge-forecast gives the same gate result, pairs and warnings from a subdirectory as from the repo root; outside git the cwd is the root; a .git cwd exits 1. verify: `node --test packages/merge-forecast/test/subdirectory-root.test.mjs`
- AC9 Existing suites green. verify: `for p in rejection-mining lesson-foundry model-ratchet skill-rot merge-forecast; do npm test -w packages/$p || exit 1; done`
- AC10 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "timeout-ms" packages/model-ratchet/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/model-ratchet.mdx && grep -c "UNVERIFIED" packages/skill-rot/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/skill-rot.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC11 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: lenient parseInt on model-ratchet --top/--churn-limit and lesson-foundry --min; lifting a shared positive-integer validator into @adlc/core; the ADLC_GRAPH_COUPLING_FILE env path resolution in merge-forecast; symlinked SKILL.md files (as opposed to directories) whose target lies in node_modules; clustering, lens rendering and routing logic.
title: llm-tools: make rejection-mining, lesson-foundry, model-ratchet, skill-rot and merge-forecast exit honestly and bound review commands
